targetText: The surplus-value produced by prolongation of the working day, I call absolute surplus-value. On the other hand, the surplus-value arising from the curtailment of the necessary labour-time, and from the corresponding alteration in the respective lengths of the two components of the working day, I call relative surplus-value.
explanation: Marx defines two ways to increase exploitation. Absolute surplus value extends the working day itself. Relative surplus value keeps the working day the same but cheapens worker goods through technology, shrinking necessary labor time and expanding surplus labor time.
